mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wms_fbo_sync_log WHERE log_no LIKE CONCAT(#{prefix}, '%')

SELECT l.id, l.log_no, l.platform, l.shop_id, s.shop_name, l.sync_type, l.total_count, l.success_count, l.fail_count, l.unmapped_count, l.sync_status, l.error_message, l.sync_time, l.duration, l.fail_details, l.auto_created_warehouse_count, l.auto_created_warehouses, l.create_time FROM wms_fbo_sync_log l LEFT JOIN shop s ON l.shop_id = s.id WHERE l.id = #{id}
